_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for retired URLs. Read by three consumers:
2. app/sitemap.ts      -> excludes these paths from the sitemap
3. app/features/page.tsx -> excludes these from the use-case link list
Adding a path here retires it everywhere at once. Removing it revives it
everywhere at once. Never hand-edit redirects in next.config.js again --
that drift is what produced the July 2026 incident, where URLs were
redirected but left in the sitemap and internal links.
RULE before adding anything here: a URL may only be retired if it targets
the SAME primary query as its destination. Do NOT retire a URL because it
has low CTR -- sitewide CTR is suppressed by AI Overviews (see
SEO_DIAGNOSIS_2026-08.md section 2.3), so low CTR at a good position means
the SERP changed, not that the page is bad. Duplication is the criterion.
